# Tesla vs. Walmart: FY2025 revenue and profitability

## Executive Summary
- Walmart generated **$681.0 billion in revenue**, about **7.18 times** Tesla’s $94.8 billion; its revenue grew **5.07%**, while Tesla’s fell **2.93%**. [1–4]
- Walmart’s attributable net income was **$19.44 billion**, versus Tesla’s **$3.79 billion**. Tesla nonetheless had the higher calculated net margin: **4.00% versus 2.85%**. [1–4]
- **The periods are not aligned:** Walmart’s FY2025 ended January 31, 2025; Tesla’s ended December 31, 2025. They overlap for only one month. [1,3]

## Revenue and profitability comparison

Dollar figures are US$ billions. Margins and year-over-year growth are calculated from the reported figures.

| Measure | Tesla FY2025 | Walmart FY2025 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Revenue | $94.827 [1,2] | $680.985 [3] |
| Revenue growth vs. FY2024 | −2.93% [2] | +5.07% [3] |
| Net income attributable to owners | $3.794 [1,2] | $19.436 [4] |
| Net margin | 4.00% [2] | 2.85% [3,4] |
| Operating income | $4.355 [2] | $29.348 [3] |
| Operating margin | 4.59% [2] | 4.31% [3] |

**Key differences — revenue:** Walmart’s revenue was approximately **$586.16 billion greater**; its growth rate exceeded Tesla’s by **8.00 percentage points** (calculated). These comparisons use different annual periods. [1–3]

**Key differences — profitability:** Walmart earned approximately **$15.64 billion more** in attributable net income, while Tesla’s net margin was higher by **1.15 percentage points** and its operating margin by **0.28 percentage points** (calculated). This suggests Tesla retained more income per revenue dollar in its fiscal year, whereas Walmart earned more in absolute dollars. [1–4]

## Overall Comparison
Walmart was substantially larger by both revenue and net income and reported positive revenue growth; Tesla had modestly higher margins but declining revenue. Different year-ends limit any like-for-like conclusion. [1–4]

**Evidence gaps and uncertainty:** Tesla’s precise figures in the table come from a secondary analysis; its 2025 filing corroborated rounded revenue and attributable net income, but the research did not independently verify every exact figure from the filing. Net margins use income attributable to owners over consolidated revenue, excluding noncontrolling interests from the numerator. Walmart’s FY2025 net income is sourced from the comparative figures in its subsequent annual report. [1,2,4]

## Sources
1. [Tesla FY2025 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026003952/tsla-20251231.htm).
2. [SEC API, Tesla FY2025 financial analysis](https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-tesla-fy2025-and-the-first-half-of-2026) — secondary source.
3. [Walmart 2025 annual report](https://corporate.walmart.com/content/dam/corporate/documents/newsroom/2025/04/24/walmart-releases-2025-annual-report-and-proxy-statement/walmart-inc-2025-annual-report.pdf), released April 24, 2025.
4. [Walmart 2026 annual report](https://stock.walmart.com/_assets/_8c8425b76a1d46bbbbc16466da2a6b9c/walmart/db/950/9988/annual_report/Walmart+2026+Annual+Report.pdf), comparative FY2025 figures.

## Research Question
For Tesla and Walmart, compare FY2025 revenue, year-over-year revenue growth, parent-attributable net income, profitability margins and fiscal year-ends.

## Key Findings
- [Fact] Tesla’s FY2025 ended December 31, 2025; Walmart’s ended January 31, 2025. Their identically named fiscal years therefore overlap for only one month.
- [Interpretation] Calculated revenue growth was −2.93% for Tesla and +5.07% for Walmart, using each company’s preceding fiscal year as the denominator.
- [Interpretation] Calculated parent-attributable net margins were 4.00% for Tesla and 2.85% for Walmart. Calculated operating margins were 4.59% and 4.31%, respectively. All use total revenue as denominator.

## Financial Facts
All dollar figures are US$ millions, GAAP, unless stated otherwise.

| Measure | Tesla FY2025 | Walmart FY2025 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Fiscal year-end | December 31, 2025 | January 31, 2025 |
| Total revenue, FY2025 | 94,827 | 680,985 |
| Total revenue, FY2024 | 97,690 | 648,125 |
| Revenue growth, calculated | (94,827 − 97,690) / 97,690 = −2.93% | (680,985 − 648,125) / 648,125 = 5.07% |
| Net income attributable to common stockholders / Walmart | 3,794 | 19,436 |
| Net margin, calculated | 3,794 / 94,827 = 4.00% | 19,436 / 680,985 = 2.85% |
| Operating income | 4,355 | 29,348 |
| Operating margin, calculated | 4,355 / 94,827 = 4.59% | 29,348 / 680,985 = 4.31% |

Tesla’s 2025 Form 10-K reports rounded revenue and common-stockholder income; the precise Tesla table figures above are from secondary analysis: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026003952/tsla-20251231.htm and https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-tesla-fy2025-and-the-first-half-of-2026. Walmart revenue and operating income: https://corporate.walmart.com/content/dam/corporate/documents/newsroom/2025/04/24/walmart-releases-2025-annual-report-and-proxy-statement/walmart-inc-2025-annual-report.pdf. Walmart attributable net income: https://stock.walmart.com/_assets/_8c8425b76a1d46bbbbc16466da2a6b9c/walmart/db/950/9988/annual_report/Walmart+2026+Annual+Report.pdf.

## Sources
- Tesla, FY2025 Form 10-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026003952/tsla-20251231.htm
- SEC API, Tesla financial analysis (secondary): https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-tesla-fy2025-and-the-first-half-of-2026
- Walmart, 2025 annual report, released April 24, 2025: https://corporate.walmart.com/content/dam/corporate/documents/newsroom/2025/04/24/walmart-releases-2025-annual-report-and-proxy-statement/walmart-inc-2025-annual-report.pdf
- Walmart, 2026 annual report, including comparative FY2025 net income: https://stock.walmart.com/_assets/_8c8425b76a1d46bbbbc16466da2a6b9c/walmart/db/950/9988/annual_report/Walmart+2026+Annual+Report.pdf

## Caveats
The requested FY2025 periods differ by 11 months; Walmart has since reported FY2026, but this is a fixed-FY2025 comparison, not a latest-period comparison. Tesla’s precise figures were retrieved from a secondary analysis; its filing excerpt independently corroborates rounded revenue and attributable income, not every exact figure. A separate secondary profile reports $3.86 billion Tesla net income without specifying attribution; its relationship to the $3.794 billion attributable figure is unverified. Net margins use parent-attributable income, excluding noncontrolling interests, over consolidated revenue; business mixes differ materially.
